꽃다발.n: any bunch of flowers given as a gift (graduation, birthday)
cf: loanword; the bride's bouquet at a wedding

맏이.n: eldest child of either sex, slightly formal
cf: spoken, parent referring to own eldest child

넋두리하다.e: to grumble; to vent; to lament
넋두리하다.n: to pour out one's troubles or sorrows at length to someone
cf: to mutter in a low voice, annoyed, often about trivial things
to complain discontentedly, openly and audibly, with sulky tone

네까짓.e: such as you; the likes of you; a petty one like you
네까짓.n: contemptuous, aimed at the listener, rude unless joking with friends
cf: standard full form, spoken, belittles a thing near the listener
trifling like this; a mere ... like this
belittling something right here, near the speaker
